text.p: Comdisco Inc said it acquired Recovery Management Inc (RMI), which develops and markets business continuity software including the REXSYS business recovery planning tool.
RMI, based in Littleton, Mass., was founded 10 years ago by Mark Avery and Randall Coleman. Both Coleman and Avery will join Comdisco, as will the remaining key RMI employees.

Comdisco will continue to support RMI's customers, as well as provide them with access to Comdisco's business continuity services, including its worldwide disaster recovery facilities, network, and other technology services.

"Over the last year, we have been aggressively building our software portfolio and expertise to ensure that we have the breadth and depth of tools needed to support customers' evolving continuity programs," John Jackson, senior vice president and general manager of Comdisco Professional Services, said in a statement. "The acquisition of both RMI's tools and talent is an important step in reaching our goal to be the leader in the business continuity software market."
Comdisco's services include asset management; business continuity, network services, equipment leasing and remarketing.
